name: Convolution
description: Real-time convolver. Strict convolution of two continuously changing inputs (target and kernel) using FFT internally.

inputs.name: in
inputs.description: Processing target signal

inputs.name: kernel
inputs.description: Processing kernel signal (continuously changing)

inputs.name: framesize
inputs.description: FFT frame size, must be a power of two (max 16384)

name: Convolution2
description: Real-time fixed kernel convolver. Strict convolution with a fixed buffer kernel that can be updated using a trigger signal.

inputs.name: in
inputs.description: Processing target signal

inputs.name: kernel
inputs.description: Buffer index for the fixed kernel (size must be <= framesize)

inputs.name: trigger
inputs.description: Update the kernel on a change from non-positive to positive value

inputs.name: framesize
inputs.description: FFT frame size, must be a power of two (max 16384)

name: Convolution2L
description: Real-time convolver with linear interpolation. Like Convolution2 but linearly crossfades between buffers when the kernel is updated.

inputs.name: in
inputs.description: Processing target signal

inputs.name: kernel
inputs.description: Buffer index for the fixed kernel

inputs.name: trigger
inputs.description: Update the kernel on a change from <=0 to >0

inputs.name: framesize
inputs.description: FFT frame size, must be a power of two (max 16384)

inputs.name: crossfade
inputs.description: Number of periods over which the crossfade is performed (integer)

name: Convolution3
description: Time-domain convolver with fixed kernel. Performs strict convolution in the time domain (only useful for very short kernels or control-rate signals).

inputs.name: in
inputs.description: Processing target signal

inputs.name: kernel
inputs.description: Buffer index for the fixed kernel

inputs.name: trigger
inputs.description: Update the kernel on a change from <=0 to >0

inputs.name: framesize
inputs.description: Maximum size of the buffer containing the kernel

name: StereoConvolution2L
description: Stereo real-time convolver with linear interpolation. Convolves a mono input with two fixed kernel buffers (left/right) and outputs a stereo signal.

inputs.name: in
inputs.description: Processing target signal

inputs.name: kernelL
inputs.description: Buffer index for the left-channel fixed kernel

inputs.name: kernelR
inputs.description: Buffer index for the right-channel fixed kernel

inputs.name: trigger
inputs.description: Update the kernel on a change from <=0 to >0

inputs.name: framesize
inputs.description: FFT frame size, must be a power of two (max 16384)

inputs.name: crossfade
inputs.description: Number of periods over which the crossfade is performed (integer)

name: PartConv
description: Real-time partitioned convolution. Mono impulse response can be arbitrarily long; CPU load grows with IR size. Requires a pre-prepared spectral buffer (see Buffer.preparePartConv).

inputs.name: in
inputs.description: Processing target signal

inputs.name: fftsize
inputs.description: Spectral convolution partition size (twice partition size); blocksize must divide it with at least two blocks per partition

inputs.name: irbufnum
inputs.description: Buffer number of the prepared spectral impulse-response data
